cases.prompt: Our libFuzzer campaign on a C parser has plateaued at about 38% coverage according to the fuzzer stats. How do I see exactly which code is not reached?
expectations: Builds a separate coverage binary with `-fprofile-instr-generate -fcoverage-mapping` and runs it over the saved corpus, rather than relying on the fuzzer's own stats.
Produces a line-level report (llvm-cov show or report) and filters out the harness code.
Turns uncovered regions into concrete work: dictionary entries for magic values, new seeds, or harness changes.

cases.prompt: When we replay our corpus through the coverage build it crashes partway and we get no report. The coverage build uses -O3.

any.why: isolates each input in a child process

expectations: Explains that a crashing input stops coverage collection, and either fixes or removes crashing inputs or runs each input in a forked child.
Recommends -O0 or -O2 for the coverage build because -O3 can remove code and skew coverage.
